topic: Capstone Testing, Documentation, and Production Readiness
learningObjectives: Create a testing strategy for the capstone application.
Document APIs, setup instructions, and important design decisions.
Prepare the project for reliable deployment and demonstration.

activities.title: Testing Strategy Map
activities.instruction: Explore what each test level validates.

content.concept: Different test levels validate different boundaries of an application, from individual functions to complete user workflows.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Test individual functions or components in isolation.
Verify that multiple components work correctly together.
Verify HTTP endpoints, request validation, responses, and API behavior.
Validate a complete user workflow through the running system.

content.concept: Production readiness combines functional verification, automated tests, secure configuration, documentation, deployment checks, and monitoring.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

goal: 2. Run automated tests and quality checks

activities.title: Documentation Builder
activities.instruction: Assemble the essential sections of a project README.

content.concept: Good documentation allows another developer to understand the project, install it, configure it, use its APIs, and understand important architectural decisions.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Production Readiness Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the action that should be taken before release.

content.concept: Production readiness means addressing important functional, security, configuration, and operational risks before exposing the application to users.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Remove hard-coded production secrets and configure them securely
Ignore failing tests because the application starts
Disable error logging to hide failures
config.answer: Remove hard-coded production secrets and configure them securely
